brief: Fighter 2 throws a right cross that lands on your head at 0.8 s if you stay in the guard; block it with the left forearm: the fist meets the forearm at about 0.8 s and never comes within 3 cm of the head.
notes: Fighter 2 plays the punch template's cross (templates/punch.json) facing the hero, placed so the fist meets the guard's head at 0.8 s. 30 fps.
